verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer can operate a full cloud browser that fills forms and handles login-gated sites, run code in a cloud Linux sandbox, and connect to 400+ services via OAuth. That is remote, cloud-side task execution, not seeing and operating applications on the user's own computer. One hands-on report says Computer sessions often fail to trigger or stall, which lowers confidence in reliability. Missing for 10: any evidence of local desktop/app control (screen viewing, mouse/keyboard operation of native apps), local OS integration, and independent corroboration that Computer reliably completes tasks.
